title: Fleet accelerators
description: Where the fleet's power goes and whether it is doing work. Sourced from each CoreWeave node's dcgm-exporter via the iris-node-agent telemetry stream, so it covers GPU clusters only -- TPU hosts report no power. Keep the window short because longer ranges scan proportionally more node telemetry. Allocation charts retain whole snapshots over seven days, with incomplete history and unavailable idle shown explicitly.

list.name: cluster
list.label: Cluster
list.description: The clusters the bridge serves (infra/grafana/src/config.py). A custom list rather than a query so a cluster that has gone silent -- exactly when you want to select it -- is still in the dropdown.

panels.title: GPU power
panels.description: Latest sample per GPU over the last 10 minutes, summed across the selected clusters.

panels.title: Mean utilization
panels.description: Mean SM utilization across the selected clusters' GPUs over the last 10 minutes.

panels.title: Mean tensor-core activity
panels.description: Fraction of time the tensor cores were active. Well below utilization means the GPUs are busy but not doing matmuls -- the classic input-pipeline or collective stall.

panels.title: Hottest GPU
panels.description: Peak GPU temperature over the last 10 minutes.

panels.title: Nodes reporting
panels.description: Distinct nodes whose agent scraped dcgm in the last 10 minutes.

panels.title: GPU power by training run
panels.description: The same watts, attributed to the run occupying each node in each bucket. '(idle / unattributed)' is draw on nodes with no Levanter process reporting -- idle capacity, non-Levanter work, or a run whose telemetry has stopped. That band is the number to drive down.

panels.title: Tensor-core activity by cluster
panels.description: Fraction of time tensor cores were active. A gap between this and utilization is time spent waiting rather than computing.

panels.title: HBM in use by cluster
panels.description: Device memory allocated across each cluster's GPUs. A step down mid-run is a process that died and restarted.

panels.title: Peak GPU temperature by cluster
panels.description: Hottest GPU in each cluster per bucket. A cluster pinned near its throttle point loses throughput before it loses a GPU.

panels.title: GPUs reporting a hardware fault
panels.description: Count of distinct GPUs with a non-zero XID code, row-remap failure or PCIe replay count. These are counters, so a flat non-zero line is a GPU that stayed faulted, not a new fault each bucket.

panels.title: Faulted GPUs
panels.description: One row per GPU carrying a fault in the last 30 minutes, worst first. Exception list: an empty table is the healthy state. The counters are cumulative, so a row here is a GPU that has faulted at some point in this boot, not necessarily now.

panels.title: Telemetry freshness
panels.description: Seconds since each cluster's newest GPU sample, with the GPU and node counts behind it. Clusters forward in bursts: a lag of minutes means the power charts' right edge is still filling in, not that the fleet went quiet.

panels.title: GPU power by device model
panels.description: The same watts grouped by the model dcgm reports, so a GB200 fleet and an H100 fleet are separable when they share a cluster. A GPU that stopped reporting before the end of the window has no model reading and lands in 'unknown'.

panels.title: SM utilization by GPU
panels.description: One time raster lane per reporting GPU, ordered by cluster, node, and device. Green is low activity, orange is high activity, and dark gaps are missing samples. SM activity is the fraction of time at least one warp was active on a streaming multiprocessor; hover for the exact GPU and value.

panels.title: GPU temperature distribution
panels.description: Core-temperature distribution across every reporting GPU. A widening or upward-moving band exposes node/device outliers hidden by the fleet maximum.

panels.title: H100 allocation by requested priority · incomplete history
panels.description: Recorded Running GPU requests at one instant, using child-job shapes and attempt lifetimes. All historical points are incomplete: node-bound setup, pod cleanup and historical allocatable capacity are not fully retained. Unknown priority covers recovered requests with an unavailable requested band; it does not include missing allocation. Idle is blank when capacity or allocation is unverified. Defaults to seven days; zoom an absolute range for finer samples. See coverage below. Missing regional reads appear as blank spans, not reduced fleet totals. Priority groups use each child job’s requested band; dispatch budget downgrades do not change that group.

panels.title: Blackwell (GB200) allocation by requested priority · incomplete history
panels.description: Recorded Running GPU requests at one instant, using child-job shapes and attempt lifetimes. All historical points are incomplete: node-bound setup, pod cleanup and historical allocatable capacity are not fully retained. Unknown priority covers recovered requests with an unavailable requested band; it does not include missing allocation. Idle is blank when capacity or allocation is unverified. Defaults to seven days; zoom an absolute range for finer samples. See coverage below. Missing regional reads appear as blank spans, not reduced fleet totals. Priority groups use each child job’s requested band; dispatch budget downgrades do not change that group.

panels.title: Allocation history coverage
panels.description: Incomplete samples include unverified historical capacity and pod setup/cleanup lifetimes. Setup requests are possible additional allocation, not allocated GPU counts. Metadata gaps may contain CPU or GPU tasks. Missing regional sources remain explicit. Fleet model gaps report requests whose GPU family cannot be resolved. They appear on both rows as the same fleet-wide gap, not as allocation assigned to either model. Setup samples count fleet-wide assigned/building tasks, including CPU tasks; GPU quantities stay blank where assignment timestamps are unavailable.

options.content: Counts are recovered Running GPU requests grouped by requested priority; budget downgrades do not change the group. Setup/binding, cleanup, metadata and capacity gaps leave all historical points incomplete, with idle blank. Unknown priority means the requested band is unavailable. Production regional metadata access is pending. See coverage below.
